collections.title: SF Masterworks
collections.intro: The first, numbered run of the SF Masterworks (1999–2007): seventy-three science fiction novels that Millennium and Gollancz reprinted as classics of the genre, in the order of their numbers. Behind each cover is the wall of the other faces we found for the book.

collections.intro: NOTE FOR JULIAN (replace before publishing): stays a draft for now (2026-09-25). 24 covers still show the old numbered design, because Open Library has no relaunch image for them: Ubik, Flow My Tears, The Simulacra, Time Out of Joint, Bring the Jubilee, The Lathe of Heaven, The Complete Roderick, The Centauri Device, Martian Time-Slip, Non-Stop, The City and the Stars, Dying Inside, Grass, Pavane, Ringworld, Timescape, The Book of Skulls, Emphyrio, Blood Music, Eon, Rendezvous with Rama, Last and First Men, A Fall of Moondust, The Child Garden. 32 of the 182 books are missing: 25 have no cover under their series ISBN, 7 ISBNs are unknown to Open Library. Details in docs/history.md, 2026-09-25.
